Description:
Augments the combat abilities of the bureaucrat's mind controlled Slave. This nano will actually 'increase' the level of the monster that is mind-controlled for a short period of time.

Due to the sever nature of this nano, it will always expire at once when the mind control nano expires. In addition, upon expirering, the monster will die from exhaustion.
